code_samples.title: Execution router
code_samples.content:
# signal_mode = "chronos_swing_v1"
# SOL/USD (33) swing directional: Chronos flip + keeper disaster SL (no profit-lock scalp).
# Load via run-directional-follow-sol-swing.sh

[execution_router]
mode = "dryrun"
execution_enabled = true
kill_switch = false
allow_live = false
wealth_usdc = [redacted]
min_delta_usd = 1.0
min_delta_mode = "fractional"
min_delta_frac = 0.05
per_venue_cap_usd = 15.0
open_signal_cap_usd = 15.0
open_collateral_cap_usd = 15.0
max_concurrent_open_legs = 1
open_leg_selection = "strongest_r_hat"
max_open_fee_frac_of_collateral = 0.20
min_liq_distance_bps = 100
protective_exit_bypass_reduce_cap = true
per_venue_reduce_cap_usd = 15.0
opportunity_rotation_enabled = false
opportunity_rotation_r_hat_margin = 0.0
max_orders_per_venue_per_minute = 6
rebalance_cooldown_ms = 0
rebalance_force_threshold_frac = 0.12
trailing_stop_enabled = false
trailing_stop_frac = 0.05
rebalance_policy = "directional_follow"
directional_r_hat_open = 6e-6
directional_r_hat_flip = 9e-6
directional_min_hold_ticks = 11
directional_post_flip_cooldown_ticks = 0
directional_close_settle_polls = 5
directional_profit_lock_r = 0.0
directional_profit_flip_relief_r = 0.0
directional_r_collateral_frac = 0.25
directional_disaster_sl_at_open = true
directional_sl_collateral_loss_frac = 0.55
directional_sl_liq_buffer_bps = 40
allowed_venues = ["gains_gtrade"]
execution_audit_ndjson_path = "./[path redacted]"
equity_live_enabled = true
wealth_usdc_cap = [redacted]

[execution_router.gains_market_costs]
enabled = true
telemetry_only = true
cache_ttl_ms = 60000
log_crowded_side_bps = 10.0
log_borrowing_bps_per_hour = 50.0
borrow_hold_relief_bps_per_hour = 100.0
min_hold_relief_ticks = 5
flip_threshold_relief_frac = 0.85
